members.name: intent_v03
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single best-fitting intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card, or the card cannot be activated.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post; the card or its PIN never came.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when a new card will arrive, expedited/fast-tracked delivery, getting it by a certain date.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical (plastic) card: how to order, fees, delivery to a country, choosing the card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card when the customer has a virtual one, or where to find the PIN of a new card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional / second / spare card, or a card for a family member on the same account.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or find a (non-disposable) virtual card, its cost.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card, who can have one.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits and restrictions of disposable virtual cards, how many times one can be used.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_linking: Linking / adding a card to the app or account, e.g. making the app show a card that arrived, or linking an existing card.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing or wanting a Visa / Mastercard.
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card does not work / stopped working (not specifically a declined payment message).
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card does not work, e.g. for online purchases.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless / tap payments do not work.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, swallowed or retained the card.
criteria.compromised_card: The customer thinks someone else has or is using their card or card details (fraud, stolen details, security of the card), without citing a specific payment.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card itself is lost or stolen; reporting it; found a lost card again.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone is lost, stolen or left behind and they need access to the app or account.
criteria.card_acceptance: General questions about which merchants or places accept the card.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Anything mentioning Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up through them (even with an Amex card inside Apple Pay). A wallet mention wins over every other cue.
criteria.change_pin: How to change the card PIN.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked after too many wrong entries; unblocking the card or account.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or login code; resetting it.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee charged for a card payment or purchase ('charged extra for using my card'); also vague complaints about hidden fees or too many fees.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A specific payment or purchase the customer did not make or does not recognise ('there is a payment I don't recognise'), including when they cite specific strange payments.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The wrong exchange rate was applied to a card payment or purchase abroad.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined or rejected, or the card was not accepted / did not go through in a shop or online.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted or returned and the money came back; also 'my payment wasn't accepted' or 'a merchant refused my payment'.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicated.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small odd extra amount on the statement, typically an extra £1, $1 or €1 or 'one pound more', even if it is pending or not recognised.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise; also vague 'what is this charge', 'unknown charge', 'unauthorised charge' or 'how do I dispute a charge' messages that speak of a charge rather than a payment and give no details.
criteria.request_refund: Requesting a refund for a purchase or how refunds work.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund that was promised has not appeared on the account yet.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs, which ATMs accept the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined or not authorised.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending / showing as in progress.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave less cash than requested or than was debited.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The wrong exchange rate was applied to a cash withdrawal abroad.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or taking a long time.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer; also SWIFT or SEPA transfer questions (even with no fee mentioned), 'how much would a transfer cost', 'why do you charge for transfers'.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How to top up or deposit cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or did not go through.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or number of top-ups.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (not specifically by card) was reverted, cancelled or returned.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up or transfer money in using a debit or credit card; also 'I topped up by card and the money disappeared'.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a card top-up; the top-up verification code.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit has not shown up in the balance.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer was made (often into the account, e.g. from the customer's UK account) but the balance has not updated or the money is not showing; includes 'how long does a UK account transfer take? I made one and it isn't showing' and 'please check my UK account / that my transfer went alright'.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A beneficiary / payee cannot be added or is not allowed; also a transfer the customer usually makes without trouble suddenly being refused as 'not possible'.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or reversing a transfer or transaction that was made.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, keeps failing, or gives an error.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending or still processing, or the customer has waited a long time for it; some 'money was sent to me and I can't see it'.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a transfer; also bare 'why was I charged?' or 'will I get extra charges?' with no transaction type given.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to add money by bank transfer or move money in from another bank account; ways to add money.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The recipient has not received money the customer sent; also generic 'it's taking too long' / 'not here yet' about a sent transfer.
criteria.transfer_timing: Pure 'how long do transfers take' questions, especially incoming transfers from the US or Europe.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from others, e.g. salary or a friend sending money.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, current rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the account can hold or receive.
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported / where the service is available.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (e.g. American Express, other card types) or currencies can be used to top up / add money, when no Apple Pay or Google Pay is mentioned.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name or address.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed or the customer cannot complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, documents needed, how long verification takes.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed or why so much personal information is asked.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Showing or verifying the source of funds / where money came from.
